'''Saben''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] leader of the [[Krayts]] gang living on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He claimed to be descended from one of the dragons his gang was named after. In [[3643 BBY]] he was killed by [[Darth Nox|Kallig]] to win the support of Nar Shaddaa's poor.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Saben appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Sith Inquisitor class mission on Nar Shaddaa
